Tourist Injured After Zipline Safety Failure in Karnataka Resort

A tourist sustained severe injuries after falling approximately 40 feet when a zipline safety lock reportedly failed at a resort in Karnataka. The incident was captured on camera, showing the tourist plunging after the equipment malfunctioned. The event highlights safety concerns at adventure tourism sites.
